episode_summary: Bill Melnick shares insights from his transition from Ralph Lauren to luxury real estate, emphasizing the importance of lifestyle marketing and strategic partnerships. He discusses the challenges of pricing unique properties and the limitations of AI in capturing market nuances. The episode offers actionable advice on using social media and photography to enhance real estate listings.
